entries.title: Review plan assignments: help on every setting, advanced settings tucked away
entries.summary: Every setting on a review plan's **Assignments** step now has an ⓘ with a plain explanation and an example, and **Learn more** opens the matching section of the [Assignments step](/evaluations/review-plan-assignments) guide. Match expertise, the plan-wide reviewer limit and saved assignments move into a collapsed **Advanced settings** section that opens by itself, marked **In use**, whenever one of them is on. Review plans no longer show a **v2** label.

where.path: Program → Review → a review plan → Edit → Assignments

entries.use_case: Program teams setting up a review can see what each assignment setting does and when to use it without leaving the screen, and the everyday setup (submissions, reviewers, reviewers per submission) is no longer crowded by settings most plans never use.

cs_action.note: On for everyone. Nothing is configured; existing plans keep their settings, and Advanced settings opens automatically on plans that already use a plan-wide limit, saved assignments or Match expertise.

internal.when_to_bring_up: When a customer is setting up committee review for the first time, asks what a Replace option will remove, or asks why a reviewer got more submissions than the limit they set.
internal.who_should_get_it: Every customer running review plans, especially first-time CFP or abstract programs.
internal.staff_path: Program → Review → a review plan → Edit → Assignments
internal.gotchas: Interest Form plans have no Advanced settings section (they have neither Match expertise nor a plan-wide limit). Legacy plans still show an amber v1 badge.

entries.title: Review plan wording on the Reports page and the Reviewers step
entries.summary: The Reports page lists the pre-built review plan reports under **Review Plan Reports**, replacing **Evaluation Plans (2.0) Reports**. On a review plan's **Reviewers** step, the description now says you can pick people already on the event or use **Add reviewer** to invite someone new by email, instead of saying reviewers must already be users. See [Custom reports](/reporting/custom-reports).

where.path: Reports → Review Plan Reports; Program → Review → a review plan → Edit → Reviewers

entries.use_case: Admins see the same Review plan wording on the Reports page as in Program → Review, and the Reviewers step no longer suggests they have to add someone to the event team before making them a reviewer.

cs_action.note: Wording only. The reports, their ids and saved report links are unchanged.

internal.when_to_bring_up: When a customer looks for the review plan reports on the Reports page, or asks how to add a reviewer who is not on the event yet.
internal.staff_path: Reports; Program → Review → a review plan → Edit → Reviewers
internal.gotchas: The report names inside the category (Evaluator Details Report and the two Consolidated grade reports) are unchanged.
